verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents form-builder capabilities: no custom screening questions, no knockout/disqualification rules, and no EEOC or demographic data collection. The 'custom application form' item describes a workaround in which candidates apply through your own website form and are pushed in via the API, which earns no credit. The careers-page items mention only auto-fill applications and translation, which are adjacent features, not form shaping.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
